an8.78:1.1: Tatra kho āyasmā Sāriputto bhikkhū āmantesi . . . pe . . .
an8.78:1.2: Chah' āvuso dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu alaṃ attano alaṃ paresaṃ.
an8.78:1.4: Idhāvuso bhikkhu khippanisanti ca hoti kusalesu dhammesu,
an8.78:1.7: attham aññāya dhammam aññāya dhammānudhammapaṭipanno ca hoti,
an8.78:1.8: kalyāṇavāco ca hoti kalyāṇavākkaraṇo poriyā vācāya samannāgato vissaṭṭhāya anelagaḷāya atthassa viññāpaniyā,
an8.78:1.9: sandassako ca hoti samādapako samuttejako sampahaṃsako sabrahmacārīnaṃ.
an8.78:1.10: Imehi kho āvuso chahi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu alaṃ attano alaṃ paresaṃ. 3.
an8.78:2.1: pañcah' āvuso dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu alaṃ attano alaṃ paresaṃ.
an8.78:2.3: Idhāvuso bhikkhu na h' eva kho khippanisanti ca hoti kusalesu dhammesu,
an8.78:2.6: attham aññāya dhammam aññāya dhammānudhammapaṭipanno ca hoti,
an8.78:2.9: Imehi kho āvuso pañcahi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu alaṃ attano alaṃ paresaṃ. 5.
an8.78:3.1: Catūh' āvuso dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu alaṃ attano no paresaṃ.
an8.78:3.3: Idhāvuso bhikkhu khippanisanti ca hoti kusalesu dhammesu,
an8.78:3.6: attham aññāya dhammam aññāya dhammānudhammapaṭipanno ca hoti,
an8.78:3.8: no ca sandassako hoti . . . pe . . . sabrahmacārīnaṃ.
an8.78:3.9: Imehi kho āvuso catūhi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu alaṃ attano no paresaṃ. 7.
an8.78:4.1: Catūh' āvuso dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu alaṃ paresaṃ no attano.
an8.78:4.3: Idhāvuso bhikkhu khippanisanti ca hoti kusalesu dhammesu,
an8.78:4.5: no ca dhatānaṃ dhammānaṃ atthupaparikkhī hoti,
an8.78:4.6: no ca attham aññāya dhammam aññāya dhammānudhammapaṭipanno hoti,
an8.78:4.9: Imehi kho āvuso catūhi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu alaṃ paresaṃ no attano. 9.
an8.78:5.1: Tīh' āvuso dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu alaṃ attano no paresaṃ.
an8.78:5.3: Idhāvuso bhikkhu na h' eva kho khippanisanti ca hoti kusalesu dhammesu,
an8.78:5.6: attham aññāya dhammam aññāya dhammānudhammapaṭipanno ca hoti,
an8.78:5.9: Imehi kho āvuso tīhi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu alaṃ attano no paresaṃ. 11.
an8.78:6.1: Tīh' āvuso dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu alaṃ paresaṃ no attano.
an8.78:6.3: Idhāvuso bhikkhu na h' eva kho khippanisanti ca hoti kusalesu dhammesu,
an8.78:6.5: no ca dhatānaṃ dhammānaṃ atthupaparikkhī hoti,
an8.78:6.6: no ca attham aññāya dhammam aññāya dhammānudhammapaṭipanno hoti,
an8.78:6.9: Imehi kho āvuso tīhi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu alaṃ paresaṃ no attano. 13.
an8.78:7.1: Dvīh' āvuso dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu alaṃ attano no paresaṃ.
an8.78:7.3: Idhāvuso bhikkhu na h' eva kho khippanisanti ca hoti kusalesu dhammesu,
an8.78:7.6: attham aññāya dhammam aññāya dhammānudhammapaṭipanno ca hoti,
an8.78:7.8: no ca sandassako hoti . . . pe . . . sabrahmacārīnaṃ.
an8.78:7.9: Imehi kho āvuso dvīhi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu alaṃ attano no paresaṃ. 15.
an8.78:8.1: Dvīh' āvuso dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu alaṃ paresaṃ no attano.
an8.78:8.3: Idhāvuso bhikkhu na h' eva kho khippanisanti ca hoti kusalesu dhammesu,
an8.78:8.4: no ca sutānaṃ dhammānaṃ dhārakajātiko hoti,
an8.78:8.5: no ca dhatānaṃ dhammānaṃ atthupaparikkhī hoti,
an8.78:8.6: no ca attham aññāya dhammam aññāya dhammānudhammapaṭipanno hoti,
an8.78:8.7: kalyāṇavāco ca hoti kalyāṇavākkaraṇo poriyā vācāya samannāgato vissaṭṭhāya anelagaḷāya atthassa viññāpaniyā,
an8.78:8.8: sandassako ca hoti samādapako samuttejako sampahaṃsako sabrahmacārīnaṃ.
an8.78:8.9: Imehi kho āvuso dvīhi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu alaṃ paresaṃ no attano ti. 1. Aṭṭh'
